about.title: Who We Are
about.text: The Higher Institute for Specialized Studies in Heliopolis is considered one of Egypt’s long-established and prestigious educational institutions. Founded in 1975, it has built a strong reputation as a leading institute in its specialized fields. The institute offers comprehensive four-year academic programs through which students earn a bachelor’s degree in one of the following majors: Tourism Studies and Hotel & Hospitality Management, Tour Guiding, Business Information Systems, and Management Information Systems. The institute is known for its high standards of education and practical training, enabling graduates to develop the skills needed to meet the evolving demands of the job market across various industries.

vision.title: Institute Vision
vision.text: To be a leading institute in delivering high-quality education and innovative scientific research that contributes to the advancement of society and the labor market, while promoting a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship to support sustainable development at both local and regional levels.

mission.title: Institute Mission
mission.text: To graduate highly qualified professionals capable of contributing to the development of local and regional labor markets across the institute’s various specializations, through a supportive environment for education, learning, and scientific research. The institute also aims to promote ethical values, foster innovation and entrepreneurship, and encourage active community engagement in pursuit of sustainable development.

guiding.short: The Tour Guiding Program aims to prepare graduates with the essential knowledge and practical skills required for a professional career in tourism guidance. It helps students develop strong communication abilities, cultural awareness, leadership, and time-management skills. The program also trains them to apply a scientific approach in handling crises and emergency situations, while ensuring they have a solid understanding of the laws and regulations governing the tourism sector.

tourism.short: The Tourism Studies Department is one of the institute’s core academic divisions, striving to achieve leadership in tourism education through both high-quality teaching and impactful scientific research. The department aims to keep pace with the continuous and rapid developments within the tourism industry, while aligning its programs with the evolving demands of local, national, and global labor markets.
intro: The Tourism Studies Department is one of the institute’s core academic divisions, striving to achieve leadership in tourism education through both high-quality teaching and impactful scientific research. The department aims to keep pace with the continuous and rapid developments within the tourism industry, addressing both theoretical foundations and real-world practices, while aligning its programs with the evolving demands of local, national, and global labor markets. It also adheres to quality assurance standards in performance and ongoing evaluation. Through its faculty members, the department continuously works to enhance teaching capabilities through training and active research, ensuring that curricula and courses are regularly updated to reflect the fast-changing economic landscape shaping today’s world.

The department equips students with advanced knowledge and skills to connect graduates with the needs of the labor market and the tourism sector in general. It organizes field trips through the institute's Training Unit to support the theoretical side and sharpen students' practical experience.

Practical training is continuous and multi-staged: it starts with group research assignments that build teamwork and IT skills, followed by a graduation project in the fourth year to design a complete tourism project, along with ongoing training in professional customer service, tour programme design to the latest international standards, and efficient use of global airline reservation systems such as Amadeus.

about.title: About the Institute
about.intro: The Higher Institute for Specialized Studies in Heliopolis — one of Egypt's long-established educational institutions since 1975.

history.text: The institute was established as a branch of the Institute of Management.
In October 1985 a ministerial approval granted it independence, and it became the Institute of Management and Computer Science in Heliopolis.
Ministerial Decree No. 248 (March 1990) established a Hotel Studies division within the institute.

Ministerial Decree No. 1273 (24/9/1992) restructured the Computer Science division into a four-year program in two stages: two years leading to the Institute Diploma, then two years leading to a bachelor's degree in Computer Science. Decree No. 1531 restructured the Tourism and Hotels division into a continuous four-year program following the academic model of the Faculty of Tourism and Hotels at Helwan University.
The institute was renamed the Institute of Specialized Studies in Heliopolis by Decree No. 857 (25/7/1994).

Decree No. 265 (February 2001) replaced the two-stage structure of the Computer Science division with a continuous four-year program. Decree No. 1535 (3/11/2001) upgraded the name to the Higher Institute for Specialized Studies in Heliopolis, offering four-year bachelor's programs under the supervision of the Ministry of Higher Education. In December 2001, Decree No. 1705 approved a unified curriculum for Management Information Systems to facilitate equivalency with the Business Administration (MIS) bachelor's degree, effective from 2001/2002.
Ministerial Decree No. 996 (28/2/2017) introduced a unified updated regulation for tourism and hospitality institutes, effective from the 2017/2018 academic year.
Ministerial Decree No. 6576 (2/11/2021) approved the credit-hour system curriculum and academic content for the Business Information Systems program, effective from the 2021/2022 academic year.

features: All academic degrees awarded by the institute are accredited by the Supreme Council of Universities and approved by the Minister of Higher Education, allowing graduates to pursue postgraduate studies at equivalent colleges.
The institute is an active member of the Association of Arab Universities.
A distinguished selection of highly qualified faculty members and teaching assistants across various academic specializations.
Classrooms and lecture halls are spacious, air-conditioned, and equipped with modern educational technologies such as overhead projectors and data-show systems.
Computer laboratories feature the latest hardware, are fully networked, and equipped with advanced software and interactive tools, all connected to high-speed internet.
The Hospitality Management Department includes a fully equipped training restaurant and teaching kitchen, plus computer labs with specialized hotel reservation systems such as Opera.
The Tourism Studies Department offers a fully simulated travel agency environment for airline ticketing training, supported by reservation software such as Amadeus.
The Tour Guiding Department features a model museum displaying replicas of Egyptian artifacts from the Ancient Egyptian, Greco-Roman, Coptic, and Islamic eras.
An accredited Microsoft Training Center providing internationally recognized IT certifications.
A partnership agreement with Oracle Academy, specializing in database technologies.
Flexible payment options for tuition fees to accommodate students’ personal circumstances.
Merit-based scholarships: first place — full tuition exemption; second place — 50%; third place — 25%.
An annual career fair connecting graduates with suitable employment opportunities.
about.equivalency: All bachelor’s degrees awarded by the institute across its various academic programs are officially recognized as equivalent to the corresponding bachelor’s degrees granted by Egyptian universities in related fields.

conferenceTexts: The department's scientific conference was held under the patronage of Prof. Sameh Fouad Habib, Chairman of the Board, and the supervision of Prof. Ghada Abdullah Mohamed, Dean. Dr. Mohamed Wagdy, Advisor to the Minister of Justice for Technology and Information, delivered a highly valuable lecture, alongside lectures by Dr. Ibrahim El-Araby and Asst. Lecturer Bassant Aly, and presentations of outstanding student projects in information systems and their modern applications, with a large turnout of department students. Thanks to Department Head Dr. Youssef Ramzy and the faculty and teaching staff.

A member of the General Assembly of the Chamber of Tourism Companies gave a lecture titled “Tourism awareness and its role in building a positive image and tourist satisfaction”, followed by Asst. Lecturer Marina Salah on “The impact of chatbot technology on the tourism sector”, with a large turnout of department students. Thanks to Department Head Prof. Amal El-Barry and the faculty and teaching staff for the organization and outstanding attendance.

The Hospitality Management Department's scientific conference was held under the patronage of Prof. Sameh Fouad Habib and the supervision of Prof. Ghada Abdullah Mohamed. Dr. Ansi Helmy, Executive Chef at Le Passage Cairo Hotel, lectured on “Success factors in food and beverage management”, alongside Asst. Lecturer Islam Mamdouh on “Adopting green human-resources practices in the Egyptian hotel industry” and Eng. Faten Qotb on “Scientific research methods in the social sciences”. Thanks to Department Head Assoc. Prof. Ahmed Abu El-Nasr.

The first scientific conference of the Tour Guiding Department, honored by the eminent archaeologist Dr. Mostafa El-Waziry, who lectured on “The latest archaeological discoveries in Egypt”, which impressed all attendees. Thanks to Prof. Shorouk Ashour, Vice Dean and Head of the Department, and the faculty and teaching staff.

The first scientific conference of the Basic Sciences Department, where Prof. Ayman El-Zohairy, professor at the American University, population expert and member of the National Council for Human Rights, lectured on “Migration and human rights – human mobility in the age of artificial intelligence”, alongside a lecture by Mr. Aly Abdallah Mohamed. Thanks to Dr. Mariam William and the faculty and teaching staff.

texts: Under the patronage of H.E. President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, the Higher Institute for Specialized Studies, Heliopolis, took part in the most important event in its history – September 2023, the Day of Excellence of Egyptian Universities and Institutes – where the honoring ceremony featured the procession of top graduates, shining under the flags of Egyptian universities and institutes, before the President at the Suez Canal Authority Stadium.

Our students attended the career fair on 4 November 2024 under the cooperation protocol previously signed between the institute and the Bazooka restaurants group. The institute was represented by Ms. Mary Tharwat, Public Relations Officer, in cooperation with the Youth Care department, and Bazooka by Mr. Ahmed Hashem, Head of Recruitment.

The Faculty of Tourism and Hotels at Suez Canal University extends its sincere thanks and appreciation to the Higher Institute for Specialized Studies for its active participation in the 13th International Scientific Conference of the Association of Arab Tourism Faculties, Institutes and Departments, “The Green Economy and the Path to Resource Management and Sustainable Tourism Development in the Arab Region”, held 23–25 November 2023. Conference chair: Prof. Nevine Galal Eid – Vice chair: Prof. Faten Hamdy El-Alimy.

On 5 February 2023, for the first time in Egypt, the unified training agreement was signed between the Higher Institute for Specialized Studies, Heliopolis – represented by Prof. Suzan Hassan Abu El-Enein, Dean – and 14 tourism colleges and institutes, with the global InterContinental hotels chain IHG, represented by Peter Frank, Regional General Manager in Egypt. The agreement aims to graduate trained technical staff qualified for the hotel job market, providing all the materials and needs for the professional advancement of trainee students, along with significant financial benefits and an accredited training certificate. Training is delivered in Arabic and English. An unprecedented agreement that stresses the importance of industry and experience working hand in hand with academics and students.

Celebrating the graduation of the first batch of the institute’s trainees on 24 October 2023 at the “InterContinental Egypt” hotels group, under the unified training agreement signed in February 2023 between the institute – represented by Prof. Suzan Hassan Abu El-Enein, Dean – and 23 tourism colleges and institutes, with the global InterContinental hotels chain IHG, represented by Peter Frank, Regional General Manager in Egypt. An unprecedented agreement that stresses the importance of industry and experience working hand in hand with academics and students.

quality.missionIntro: The Quality Assurance Unit is committed to:
mission: Spreading and deepening a quality culture among faculty members, their assistants, staff and beneficiaries.
Qualifying the institute according to quality-standards requirements.
Gaining society's trust in the institute's graduates and achieving local competitiveness.
Strengthening community engagement and environmental service through research and service activities.
quality.goalsIntro: Preparing the institute for accreditation and ensuring and developing the quality of education through the following:
goals: Building comprehensive databases for the institute in both the educational and institutional fields.

Setting and implementing a performance-measurement system (programs, courses, academic and administrative performance, community engagement, graduate skills, intended learning outcomes, research, educational and student activities, effectiveness of quality management).
Setting and implementing a performance-evaluation, review and corrective-action system.
Preparing and delivering training programs to ensure continuous development.
Elevating the institute's institutional and academic performance through improvement and enhancement programs.
Promoting the values of excellence and competitiveness among faculty, their assistants and staff.
quality.established: The Quality Assurance Unit was established by a decision of the Board of the Higher Institute for Specialized Studies, Heliopolis, dated 27/11/2008.
